keyVerseDR: "The blind see, the lame walk... the poor have the gospel preached to them." (Mt 11:5)

level1.title: Jesus Brings Joy
level1.story: John asked, "Jesus, are You the One?" Jesus said, "The blind see and the lame walk!" Good news makes us happy!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you make someone smile?
level1.prayer: Jesus, fill my heart with joy. Amen.

activity.title: Joy for everyone!
activity.intro: Jesus brings joy. Draw a happy face for each person He helped.

level2.title: Are You the One?
level2.story: John the Baptist was in prison, and he sent his disciples to ask Jesus, "Are You the one who is to come?" Jesus answered, "Go and tell John what you hear and see." The blind see, the lame walk, lepers are made clean, and the poor hear good news. Jesus said John was the messenger sent to prepare His way. This Gaudete Sunday we rejoice, because the Savior is near!
level2.keyLine: Go and relate to John what you have heard and seen.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How do Jesus' actions show who He is?
How can your actions show you follow Jesus?
level2.prayer: Jesus, let my life show others Your joy. Amen.

activity.title: Isaiah said... Jesus did!
activity.intro: Match what the prophet foretold to what Jesus did.
pairs: The eyes of the blind will be opened
The lame will leap like a deer
I send My messenger ahead of You
John the Baptist prepared the way

art.mainBrief: John in prison window; his friends watch Jesus healing a blind man
art.heartBrief: Smiling faces & sunbeams; pink Gaudete candle at top
